يستذنبون (form X)
# يَسْتَذْنِبُونَ (yastaḏnibūna) /jas.tað.ni.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# يُسْتَذْنَبُونَ (yustaḏnabūna) /jus.tað.na.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
